title: fix(fields): name the boolean cell's read-only checkbox by its field (objectui#12584)
body:
Fixes #12584
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The boolean cell renderer (`BooleanCellRenderer` in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`) draws a plain read-only checkbox for every boolean column outside the completion and status names. That checkbox had no accessible name, so a screen reader announced each grid cell as a bare "checkbox, not checked", with no field. It is now named by the field:

- One local value, `fieldLabel`: the field's label, else its humanized name. The off badge's text and the checkbox's `aria-label` both read it, so the expression is written once.
- No state word in the name: the `checkbox` role announces checked or not checked itself. No new i18n key, no visual change (no class moved), no prop, export or type change. The `Checkbox` primitive is untouched.
- The humanized fallback reads the field name as authored, not the lower-cased matching key (A3 below). Matching against the completion names and `STATUS_FIELD_NAMES` still uses the lower-cased key, unchanged.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- **A1: the primitive forwards `aria-label` to the role element.** Holds. Every naming pin finds its box with `getByRole('checkbox', { name })`, which reads the name off the element that carries `role="checkbox"` (Radix's button), not off a wrapper. The source agrees: the `Checkbox` wrapper spreads its props onto `CheckboxPrimitive.Root`.
- **A2: the grid hosts add no name of their own.** Holds, read from both hosts' cell wrappers. The data-table renderer draws `col.cell(...)` inside a `TableCell` and a `div` that carries only `className`, `title` and `data-auto-width-key`. `VirtualGrid` wraps it in a `div` with a class only. Neither sets `aria-labelledby` or `aria-label`, so nothing is named twice. The card's CDP reading (9 unnamed `checkbox` nodes) is the runtime face of the same fact.
- **A3: `fieldName` is the lower-cased name.** True. `humanizeLabel` only capitalises the first letter of each word, so the lower-cased key read an unlabelled mixed-case name wrong. Measured on `humanizeLabel` itself (`packages/core/src/utils/humanize-label.ts`):

  | name | humanized as authored (now) | humanized lower-cased (before) |
  |---|---|---|
  | `IsPreferred` | `IsPreferred` | `Ispreferred` |
  | `is_preferred` | `Is Preferred` | `Is Preferred` |
  | `is_active` | `Is Active` | `Is Active` |
  | `IS_ACTIVE` | `IS ACTIVE` | `Is Active` |

  So the fallback now reads the name as authored, for the checkbox and the off badge alike, as the dispatch ruled. For every spec-legal name the words are byte-identical: the spec refuses an object field name that is not lowercase snake_case ("Field names must be lowercase snake_case"). The off badge's text moves only for an unlabelled, off-spec status name with an upper-case letter inside a word (for example `IS_ACTIVE`: "IS ACTIVE — Off", where it read "Is Active — Off"). `humanizeLabel` does not split camelCase, by its documented design, so `IsPreferred` reads `IsPreferred`, not "Is Preferred": the better of the two readings, not a perfect one.

## Tests

New file `packages/fields/src/__tests__/booleanCell.accessibleName-12584.test.tsx`. It renders through `getCellRenderer(resolveCellRendererType(...))`, the way a grid host resolves a read-mode cell, for both `boolean` and `toggle`:

- a labelled field, checked and unchecked: `getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Preferred' })`;
- an unlabelled field: the humanized name, `Is Preferred`;
- an unlabelled mixed-case name: `IsPreferred` (A3);
- a status field that is on (`is_active`, `true`): the box named `Active`, the measured HotCRM cell;
- CONTROL: the completion indicator keeps "Completed" / "Not completed" and draws no checkbox; the off badge keeps "Active — Off" / "Is Active — Off" and draws no checkbox; a non-boolean value draws the `EmptyValue` affordance ("No value") and no checkbox.

**Ablation.** The fix was committed first. The mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs`, deleting ` aria-label={fieldLabel}`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `8d8a77e75ac8` to `433e77c56102`, on-disk count 0 inside the run. Result: `Tests 10 failed | 3 passed (13)`. All 10 naming pins went red with "Unable to find an accessible element with the role "checkbox" and name ...", and the 3 CONTROLs stayed green. Restore proven: blob equals HEAD `8d8a77e75ac8`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `../index` relatively, so the subject resolves to source, not `dist/`, and no rebuild was needed for the mutation to reach it.

Runs, local, on a shared box, through the verify lock:

- the new file: `Tests 13 passed (13)` at `63ba527469`;
- every `packages/fields` suite named for boolean (5 files): `Tests 103 passed (103)` at `63ba527469`;
- the whole `@object-ui/fields` suite: `Test Files 257 passed | 1 skipped (258)`, `Tests 4084 passed | 7 skipped (4091)` at `789a28d784`. The only later commit retypes the new test's render helper (`as any` to `as never`);
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check`, after building its dependency closure (11 of 47 projects): exit 0 at `63ba527469`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test file;
- the census and ratchet sweep, the suites whose subject this diff touches (aria-label literal census, icon-only button census, machine-locale census, ellipsis glyph, emptiness floor, `humanizeLabel`, grid cell face label, detail section, widget DOM-leak sweep, catalog gallery render): `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 878 passed (878)` at `789a28d784`.

## Gates

Local subset at the final head `63ba527469`, each exit captured before any pipe: `check:control-bytes` 0, `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new citations), `check-changeset-presence` 0, `check-changeset-no-major` 0, `check-changeset-claims` 0, `check-governed-queue-guard --test` NOT GOVERNED. At `789a28d784`, also 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:test-path-roots`, the three `check:vi-mock-*`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check-type-check-coverage`. ESLint on the two changed source files: 0 errors, no warning in the changed lines of `index.tsx`, none in the new test. The full farm is CI's.

## What the landing seat's browser reading should show

HotCRM, the Account list (the runtime list grid; the Studio Records grid draws the same renderer), the `is_active` column. In the browser's accessibility tree (CDP `Accessibility.getFullAXTree`), each row whose `is_active` is true is a `checkbox` node, checked, named by the field's label: "Active" under en (HotCRM declares `label: 'Active'`), the translated column label under another locale. None has an empty name, and no name carries "Yes", "No", "true" or "false". Rows whose `is_active` is false still draw the destructive "Active — Off" badge, unchanged, and no checkbox. Any other boolean column outside the completion and status names reads the same way: one named checkbox per row.

## Acceptance notes

- Observation, not filed (read from source, not reproduced in a browser): the data-table cell wrapper sets `title` to `String(cellValue)` for any non-object value, so hovering a boolean cell shows a raw `true` / `false` tooltip, in English under every locale. It does not name the checkbox: a `title` on an ancestor `div` is not part of the checkbox's name. Carrier: none.
